Summary: Your PC crashed with a blue screen linked to the NVIDIA graphics driver. The issue started after a driver update.
likely_cause: A recent NVIDIA graphics driver update (nvlddmkm.sys) caused instability, leading to blue screens and driver resets.
Evidence: Blue screen at Fri 10:32:05 PM with BugcheckCode 0x116 and param1=nvlddmkm.sys
Graphics driver reset at Fri 2:32:05 AM, shortly after NVIDIA driver installation on Tue 4:12:05 PM
No memory or CPU usage data available during the crash period
Only one driver change recorded in the past 3 days
Steps: Uninstall the latest NVIDIA graphics driver from Device Manager.
Restart your PC to let Windows reinstall a stable driver automatically.
Check if the blue screen returns after restart.
If it does, contact NVIDIA support for driver troubleshooting.
